title: Grok CLI vs Grok Build: Two Agents, One `grok`

facts.fact: The community Grok CLI project (superagent-ai/grok-cli) was created on 2025-07-14.
facts.quote: The community project was created on 2025-07-14. xAI created theirs on 2026-07-14

facts.fact: xAI's official Grok Build (xai-org/grok-build) was created on 2026-07-14.
facts.quote: xAI created theirs on 2026-07-14, exactly one year later

facts.fact: On 2026-07-20, the Grok CLI repository had 3,314 GitHub stars, per the page's first-hand read.
Grok CLI's harness is licensed under MIT, while Grok Build's harness is licensed under Apache-2.0.
facts.quote: | Harness license | MIT | Apache-2.0 |

facts.fact: Grok CLI's release assets include no linux-arm64 build; the grok-linux-arm64 URL returned HTTP 404 on the page's 2026-07-20 probe.
facts.quote: | `grok-linux-arm64` | Grok CLI | **404, not published** |

facts.fact: Grok Build publishes a grok-0.2.106-linux-aarch64 release asset, which returned HTTP 200 on the page's 2026-07-20 probe.
facts.quote: | `grok-0.2.106-linux-aarch64` | Grok Build | **200, first-class target** |

facts.fact: Grok CLI's grok-linux-x64 release asset returned HTTP 200 on the page's 2026-07-20 probe.
facts.quote: | `grok-linux-x64` | Grok CLI | 200 |

facts.fact: The page's Grok CLI 1.1.7 binary in a clean Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 container was reported as 117 MB.
facts.quote: `grok --version` reported 1.1.7 against a 117 MB binary.

facts.fact: The page describes Grok CLI's install as npm package grok-dev, while Grok Build has no npm package.
facts.quote: | npm package | `grok-dev` | None |

facts.fact: Grok Build's version output on the page's probe was 0.2.106 with a short commit hash, and Grok CLI reports its npm version such as 1.1.7.
facts.quote: `grok --version` on Grok Build prints a version plus a short commit hash, like `0.2.106 (ab5ebf69ac)`. The community CLI reports its npm version, `1.1.7`.

facts.fact: Grok Build had 20,734 stars in six days, compared with 3,314 for the community project after one year.
facts.quote: 20,734 stars in six days against the community project's 3,314 in a year

facts.fact: Grok CLI's last push was 2026-07-06, while Grok Build's last push was on the page's date of 2026-07-20.
facts.quote: its last push was today while Grok CLI's was 2026-07-06

facts.fact: Grok Build is a Rust binary, and the page describes the Grok CLI binary as a TypeScript agent loop on Bun.
facts.quote: far easier to modify than a 146 MB Rust binary

facts.fact: Cosyra's plans each include 120 hours of compute per month, with hibernation after ten minutes of idle time.
facts.quote: Each plan is 120 hours of compute a month with hibernation after ten minutes idle

facts.fact: Cosyra's plans start at $20 per month.
facts.quote: Plans start at $20/month.

facts.fact: Cosyra's Ubuntu container runs Ubuntu 24.04 on x86_64 Azure AKS.
facts.quote: Ours is an Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 container on Azure AKS

facts.fact: Grok CLI's installer accepts Darwin, Linux, and Windows and exits with code 1 on any other platform.
facts.quote: Grok CLI's installer accepts Darwin, Linux, and Windows and exits 1 on anything else

facts.fact: Grok CLI's npm package grok-dev declares engines node >=18 with no CPU restriction.
facts.quote: `grok-dev` declares `engines: node >=18` with no CPU restriction.

facts.fact: The page reports that Grok Build's linux-aarch64 asset is a first-class target while Grok CLI's arm64 asset is unpublished, making the ARM support inverted between the two projects.
facts.quote: Their Linux ARM64 support is exactly inverted.

facts.fact: Grok CLI (superagent-ai/grok-cli) is a community project whose README states it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by xAI Corp.
facts.quote: Its README carries an explicit disclaimer that it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by xAI Corp.

facts.fact: The path github.com/xai-org/grok-cli returns 404, as checked on 2026-07-20, so no official xAI repository exists at that path.
facts.quote: There is no repository at `xai-org/grok-cli`; that path returns 404, checked 2026-07-20.

facts.fact: The npm package grok-dev, identified as the current Grok CLI package, is at version 1.1.7, published 2026-05-15.
facts.quote: `grok-dev`, currently 1.1.7, published 2026-05-15.

facts.fact: The older npm package @vibe-kit/grok-cli stopped at version 0.0.34 on 2025-11-27.
facts.quote: The older `@vibe-kit/grok-cli` stopped at 0.0.34 on 2025-11-27

facts.fact: Grok Build has no npm package, according to the page.
facts.quote: Grok Build has no npm package at all.

facts.fact: Both Grok CLI and Grok Build install a binary named grok into $HOME/.grok/bin, so installing one can overwrite the other.
facts.quote: Both install a binary named `grok` into `$HOME/.grok/bin`, so whichever you installed most recently wins

facts.fact: Grok Build links a second command, agent, to the same binary as grok.
facts.quote: Grok Build also links a second command, `agent`, to the same binary.

facts.fact: Grok CLI publishes grok-darwin-arm64, grok-linux-x64, and grok-windows-x64.exe but no grok-linux-arm64 asset.
facts.quote: Grok CLI publishes `grok-darwin-arm64`, `grok-linux-x64`, and `grok-windows-x64.exe`, but no `grok-linux-arm64`.

facts.fact: On 2026-07-20 the grok-linux-arm64 asset URL for Grok CLI returned 404 while the x64 asset returned 200.
facts.quote: We probed that asset URL on 2026-07-20 and it returns 404 while the x64 asset returns 200.

facts.fact: Grok Build's linux-aarch64 binary returned HTTP 200 in the page's check.
facts.quote: its `linux-aarch64` binary is a first-class target and returns 200.

facts.fact: The Grok CLI harness (superagent-ai/grok-cli) is MIT-licensed TypeScript, while the Grok Build harness is Apache-2.0 Rust.
facts.quote: `superagent-ai/grok-cli` is MIT-licensed TypeScript you can fork and audit

facts.fact: The Grok model called by these tools is proprietary, and xAI bills users for API usage through their own key.
facts.quote: The Grok model it calls is proprietary and xAI bills you for API usage through your own key.

facts.fact: Cosyra's Linux environment is Ubuntu 24.04, per the vendor's own description.
facts.quote: Ubuntu 24.04 with Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, and Antigravity CLI pre-installed.
